meta.description: Mock dataset simulating VLLM-generated captions per video snapshot. Each video has snapshots at 10-second intervals with generated captions.

snapshots.caption: A dark mountain silhouette against a pre-dawn sky with faint orange glow on the horizon. Stars are still visible above the peaks.
The first rays of sunlight begin to illuminate the mountain peaks, casting a warm orange and pink hue across the snow-capped summit.
Sunlight spreads further down the mountain face, revealing rocky textures and patches of pine forest at the base. The sky transitions from orange to golden.
The sun crests the horizon in full view, flooding the valley below with golden light. Mist rises from the tree-covered lower slopes.
Bright daylight now illuminates the entire scene. The sky is clear blue, the mountain peaks are sharply defined, and the valley is bathed in warm sunlight.
Clouds begin drifting across the peaks, casting dynamic shadows that move across the mountain face. The timelapse captures the changing light patterns.
A full golden hour scene with the sun positioned above the peaks, long shadows stretching across the valley, and a flock of birds flying in the distance.
A bustling night market with colorful string lights hanging overhead. Stalls line both sides of the narrow street with steam rising from multiple food carts.
Close-up of a vendor flipping noodles in a large wok over a high flame. Sparks and steam rise as sauces are tossed with vegetables and meat.
A customer receives a plate of pad thai wrapped in banana leaf. The dish is garnished with crushed peanuts, lime wedge, and fresh cilantro.
Wide shot of the market from an elevated angle. Crowds of people walk between stalls holding skewers, cups, and plates. Neon signs glow in the background.
A dessert stall displays rows of colorful mango sticky rice portions wrapped in plastic. A vendor pours warm coconut sauce over a freshly prepared plate.
Night market scene winding down. Some vendors begin cleaning their stations while late-night customers browse the remaining open stalls under dimmer lighting.
A wooden workbench cluttered with robot arm components: servo motors, aluminum brackets, Arduino board, screwdrivers, and a spool of 3D printer filament.
Hands attaching the base servo motor to the wooden platform using M4 screws. The wiring diagram is visible on a laptop screen in the background.
The lower arm segment being connected to the shoulder joint. Red and black jumper wires are carefully routed along the side of the aluminum arm.
Elbow joint assembly with two servo motors mounted back-to-back. The wiring harness is secured with zip ties to keep it organized.
The gripper mechanism being attached to the end of the robot arm. It has two parallel fingers with rubber padding for grip.
Full robot arm assembled and connected to the Arduino. The laptop screen shows the Arduino IDE with control code being uploaded to the board.
The robot arm in motion, picking up a small wooden block and moving it from one marked position to another. The movement is smooth and precise.
A wide shot of the ocean at golden hour. The sky is painted in shades of orange, purple, and pink, reflected on the calm water surface.
A medium wave rolls toward the shore, its crest catching the warm sunset light and appearing translucent with a golden glow.
The wave crashes onto the sandy beach, creating white foam that spreads across the wet sand. The foam reflects the colorful sky above.
Water recedes back into the ocean, leaving a smooth, reflective layer of water on the sand. Footprints from a previous beachgoer are visible.
The sun dips below the horizon, casting a final deep red glow. The sky transitions to twilight with the first stars beginning to appear.
A raw ribeye steak on a wooden cutting board, seasoned generously with coarse salt and black pepper. A sprig of rosemary and garlic cloves sit nearby.
A cast iron skillet heating on a gas stove with butter and olive oil. The pan begins to shimmer, indicating it is hot enough for searing.
The steak is placed in the hot skillet, producing a loud sizzle. A cloud of aromatic smoke rises as the Maillard reaction begins on the surface.
The steak is flipped, revealing a deep golden-brown crust. Butter is being spooned over the top along with rosemary and crushed garlic for basting.
The cooked steak rests on a cutting board, tented with foil. Juices pool around the base. The crust is evenly browned and visually appealing.
The steak is sliced against the grain, revealing a perfect medium-rare interior with a pink center. The slices are arranged on a plate with roasted vegetables.

videos.title: Coding Session - Building a Web App

snapshots.caption: A VS Code editor window open with a TypeScript file displayed. The sidebar shows a React project structure with components, hooks, and styles folders.
A developer types out a React functional component for a user dashboard. The code includes useState and useEffect hooks for data fetching.
The terminal panel shows npm install running, installing dependencies for a new package. The command 'npm install @tanstack/react-query' is visible.
A browser window split-screened with the code editor. The web app shows a basic layout with a sidebar navigation and a main content area.
The developer adds Tailwind CSS classes to style the dashboard components. The preview auto-updates with new styling changes.
A pull request diff is displayed in the GitHub interface. The PR adds a new API integration with error handling and loading states.
The final web app running in a browser with a dark theme UI. It shows a data table with sortable columns and a search bar that filters results.
View from inside a car driving through a city at night. Raindrops streak across the windshield, and the streetlights create blurred bokeh effects.
The car approaches a traffic intersection. Red taillights of other vehicles reflect off the wet asphalt, creating mirror-like reflections on the road.
A pedestrian with an umbrella crosses the street in front of the car. Neon signs from nearby shops cast colorful reflections on the wet pavement.
The car turns onto a bridge overlooking the city skyline. The buildings are lit up, and their lights blur softly through the rain-streaked window.
Driving through a tunnel with bright fluorescent lights creating a rhythmic pattern as the car passes each light fixture.
A person sits cross-legged on a yoga mat in a sunlit room. Eyes closed, hands resting on knees in a peaceful meditation pose.
Transitioning into a cat-cow stretch on all fours. The spine arches upward as the person exhales, with the morning light streaming through window blinds.
Moving into a downward dog position. The body forms an inverted V shape, with heels pressing toward the mat and shoulders relaxing away from the ears.
Warrior II pose with the front knee bent at 90 degrees, arms extended in opposite directions, and gaze focused over the front hand.
A tree pose balance sequence. Standing on one leg with the other foot pressed against the inner thigh, hands raised above the head in a steady position.
Savasana final relaxation pose lying flat on the mat. The person appears calm and relaxed, with soft breathing and a gentle expression.
An acoustic guitar resting on a lap. The camera focuses on the fretboard showing the open position with the soundhole visible in the background.
A hand demonstrates the correct posture for fingerstyle playing: thumb resting on the bass string, index, middle, and ring fingers hovering over the treble strings.
The thumb plucks the low E string producing a bass note. The finger movement is demonstrated in slow motion to show the proper plucking technique.
A simple fingerpicking pattern is played: thumb on bass strings followed by index, middle, and ring fingers on the treble strings in sequence.
The chord progression C major, G major, and A minor is demonstrated with the fingerpicking pattern applied to each chord.
A short melody is played using the fingerstyle technique, combining the bass line with a simple melody on the higher strings simultaneously.
The full song excerpt is played through, combining all the techniques shown earlier. The playing sounds fluid and musical.
A tabby cat crouches low in the grass, eyes fixed on a butterfly. Its tail twitches back and forth in a hunting stance.
The cat pounces forward, missing the butterfly, and tumbles into a patch of daisies. It quickly recovers and looks around as if embarrassed.
A second orange cat joins from behind a bush. The two cats sniff each other, then begin playfully wrestling in the grass with paws batting.
Both cats lie side by side on a sun-warmed stone path, grooming themselves. The afternoon light filters through the garden leaves above them.
A black background with a single glowing geometric shape — a torus knot — slowly rotating at the center. The surface has a metallic gradient finish.
The shape begins to morph and pulse, changing color from deep blue to vibrant magenta. Small particle effects orbit around the central form.
Multiple clones of the shape appear in a grid pattern, each with slightly different colors and rotation speeds, creating a mesmerizing kaleidoscope effect.
The shapes converge back into a single form, which then fades out with a soft glow, leaving the screen black before the loop restarts.
A pour-over coffee setup on a kitchen counter: a V60 dripper placed on a glass carafe, a gooseneck kettle, and a bag of freshly ground coffee beans.
A paper filter is placed in the dripper and rinsed with hot water. The water drains into the carafe, warming the vessel and removing paper taste.
Ground coffee is added to the filter and leveled. A digital scale shows 15 grams of coffee. The person gently taps the dripper to settle the grounds.
The bloom phase: a small amount of hot water is poured over the grounds, causing them to release CO2 and bubble up. A timer shows 30 seconds elapsed.
Slow, circular pouring continues. The water level rises and drains through the coffee bed. The scale shows 250 grams of water added.
The final brew drips through the filter. The carafe contains a dark, aromatic coffee. The person picks up the carafe and pours into a ceramic mug.
Aerial drone shot of rugged coastal cliffs rising from the ocean. The camera slowly pans from left to right, revealing the scale of the rock formations.
The drone descends along the cliff face, revealing layers of sedimentary rock in shades of brown, orange, and gray. Waves crash against the base far below.
A sea arch is visible carved into the cliff by erosion. The drone flies through the arch, emerging on the other side with an open ocean view.
The drone ascends to reveal a panoramic view of the coastline. A sandy beach stretches along the base of the cliffs, and the ocean gradient goes from turquoise to deep blue.
The drone pulls back to a wide shot, showing the cliffs receding into the distance along the coastline. The sun reflects off the water with a sparkling effect.
A street basketball court in an urban park. Two players face off at the three-point line, one dribbling and the other in a defensive stance.
The offensive player performs a crossover dribble, faking left and driving right past the defender. The defender scrambles to recover.
A jump shot released from the free-throw line. The ball arcs through the air against a backdrop of city buildings and a blue sky.
The ball swishes through the net. The player lands and raises three fingers. The defender shakes their head with a smile. Other players on the sidelines react.
A final slow-motion replay of the shot from a different angle, showing the ball's trajectory and the net movement as it passes through.
A tight bud of a pink rose sits on a green stem against a black backdrop. Dewdrops glisten on the tightly closed petals.
The outer petals begin to unfurl slowly, peeling away from the center. The deep pink outer petals contrast with the lighter inner layers.
The rose is half-opened, revealing the spiral pattern of its inner petals. The bloom continues expanding outward in a graceful motion.
The flower reaches full bloom with all petals fully expanded. The center stamen is visible, coated in yellow pollen.
The fully opened rose sways gently, petals now fully relaxed and wide. The sunlight passing through the petals creates a soft translucent effect.
A bee lands on the center of the fully bloomed rose, collecting pollen. The petals are at their widest and most vibrant stage.
The rose begins to close slightly as the time-lapse cycle nears completion, with petals slowly drawing inward in the fading light.
A lump of wet clay centered on a spinning pottery wheel. The potter's hands are wet, gently cupping the clay as it spins.
The potter presses a thumb into the center of the spinning clay to create an opening. Water splashes slightly as the hands guide the shape.
The walls of the clay are pulled upward between both hands, forming a cylinder. The spinning motion creates concentric lines on the surface.
The cylinder is shaped into a bowl form, with one hand inside applying pressure and the other outside guiding the curve.
The rim of the bowl is refined and smoothed using a damp sponge. Excess clay and slip are cleaned from the wheel base.
The finished bowl shape is separated from the wheel using a wire tool. The potter carefully lifts it onto a wooden drying board.
A close-up of the finished bowl with visible spinning rings on the surface. The clay appears smooth and evenly shaped.
A cluttered car interior before cleaning: dust on the dashboard, crumbs on the seats, and scattered receipts in the cup holders.
A vacuum nozzle runs along the floor mats, removing dirt and debris. The before-and-after difference is already visible on the cleaned section.
A detailing brush and compressed air are used to clean the air vents and dashboard crevices. Dust particles fly out from the vents.
Leather conditioner is applied to the seats using a foam applicator pad. The leather darkens and develops a rich, even sheen.
Glass cleaner is sprayed on the windshield and wiped with a microfiber cloth, leaving a streak-free clear surface.
The final result: a spotless interior with gleaming dashboard, conditioned leather seats, clean floor mats, and crystal-clear windows.
